info.title: Traigent TVL Reactive Contracts Routes
info.description: Closed wire contracts of the TVL 1.4 reactive layer (TRAIG-101, S1): evaluation-batch staging, producer watermarks, human approval grants, reservations, start authorization, effect outcome facts, cancel, attempt and notification read models. Reviewed closed-contract expansion (GNFR-PRIV-002(f)); see docs/tvl-reactive-contracts.md.

post.summary: Stage facts for one evaluation instant
post.description: TraigentBackend (planned) production reactive routes. Principals: P-ingest (SDK API key scoped to the agent) for customer-monitor and optimization-reporter facts; native-monitor facts are P-system only (403 fact_source_not_permitted). Tenant and project come from the authenticated request context only (X-Tenant-Id, query strings and unknown body fields are never consulted or are refused). Dark behind PRODUCTION_REQUIREMENTS_ENABLED: while off the route answers the uniform unknown-route 404. Every error body is the closed envelope tvl_reactive_common_schema.json#/definitions/Refusal except 429.
